summary: Live HTTP + admin-UI test of Empresa public flow additions (status magic-link, resubmit-after-reject token, admin reject wiring). Backend: 11/11 executed tests PASS (2 skipped only because tests/conftest.py auto-injects the captcha bypass header; captcha enforcement checked manually with curl: empty token -> 400 CAPTCHA_REQUIRED, 'x' token -> 400 CAPTCHA_FAILED). Signup regression OK (pending doc, 2 documents, no users doc, duplicate pending -> 409). status-link gives the same generic 200 for unknown and known emails (also case-insensitive); for the known email it stores a 64-char status_token_digest + expires_at. Bad status/resubmit tokens -> 404, malformed resubmit body -> 422. Admin reject via API AND via admin UI (/admin/users?tab=company-kyb: row shows, reject dialog, note, confirm, toast 'Request rejected', row leaves the pending filter) leaves the DB with status=rejected, admin_note=<reason>, resubmit_token_digest/expires_at (+72h) set, resubmit_token_used_at=null, password_hash removed, reviewed_by=admin. Rejecting a second time -> 409; normal signup with the same email afterwards -> 429 (7-day cooldown, as intended). No unhandled exceptions in the reject path. The only email errors were Resend refusing @example.com recipients, which is expected and caught. Frontend: /empresa/seguimiento renders the email input, a Turnstile widget and a send button (disabled until the captcha is solved, which is expected). 'Volver al inicio' goes to '/'. /empresa/seguimiento/<bad> shows company-status-error and /empresa/reenviar/<bad> shows company-resubmit-error, both in Spanish.

minor.issue: The payload's account_email is not required to match the rejected request's email. A valid resubmit token therefore skips the 7-day cooldown for ANY email. It also creates a new pending request for that email, even one that is not tied to the rejection. Suggest forcing account_email = the original doc's email (or rejecting a mismatch).

The token is consumed AFTER _persist_company_signup. Two concurrent resubmits that use different emails could both succeed, because the unique pending index is per email. Suggest claiming the token with a CAS update before persisting, and releasing it if persisting fails.

There is no rate limit or per-email cooldown, so anyone who passes the captcha can repeatedly trigger emails to an address that has a request. Each call also rotates the token, which invalidates earlier links. Consider a short per-request resend cooldown.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Users > Company KYB reject dialog
issues: The copy 'El cliente podrá volver a solicitar en 7 días' (adminCompanyRequests.rejectDialogBody, es.json:2667) is now wrong for anonymous public requests: they get a resubmit link that skips the cooldown. Update the text or make it conditional on requester_anonymous.

action_items: Bind the resubmit POST to the original account_email, or validate that it matches
Claim the resubmit token atomically before creating the new request
Optional: add a per-email cooldown to status-link
Update the reject-dialog copy for anonymous requests (resubmit link, no 7-day wait)
critical_code_review_comments: routes/company_requests.py is 1329 lines; consider splitting the public signup/status/resubmit endpoints into their own module

The reject email and token storage sit in a single try/except. If the token update succeeds but email sending fails, only an error is logged and the admin is not told the applicant never received the link
seed_data_creation: Temporary company_requests with test_*@example.com emails were created and all deleted at the end. No users docs were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: tests/conftest.py auto-adds the X-Captcha-Bypass header to requests calls, so negative captcha tests have to use curl. Admin KYB lives at /admin/users?tab=company-kyb; testids are company-request-row-<id>, company-reject-<id>, company-reject-note and company-reject-confirm. Resend rejects @example.com recipients (expected, the error is caught).
